sar.narrative: Between 2016-11-17 and 2016-11-17, card C03042-K1 belonging to customer C03042 was subject to unauthorized transactions totaling $599.94 USD. The activity was categorized under pattern 'card_not_present_new_device', conducted via online channel. Cardholder verification confirmed that the cardholder did not authorize the transactions and remained in possession of the card. Investigation of the associated infrastructure identified device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 8.1 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1680x1050', which is linked to 7 other cardholder accounts (C11413-K1, C11227-K2, C01155-K2), indicating a coordinated compromise. In accordance with Bank Fraud Policy Rule R6, a Suspicious Activity Report is filed. Card C03042-K1 has been blocked and connected accounts placed under enhanced monitoring.

stop_reason: Account baseline and evidence established clear finding without requiring step-up validation.
